head: Informeel
Formeel
Nederlands
rows: I would like to enquire about ...
I would be grateful if you could send me ...
I look forward to hearing from you.

blocks.title: Nederlands is directer
blocks.text: Nederlanders vallen in het Engels soms bot uit: Send me the information. In het Engels, zeker in formele teksten, verpak je een verzoek beleefd: Could you possibly ...?, I would be grateful if ..., I was wondering if .... Gebruik in formele teksten ook geen korte vormen (I'm, don't).

head: Onderdeel
Formeel
Informeel
rows: Dear Mr Jones, / Dear Sir or Madam,
I am writing to complain about ...
It was great to hear from you!
I would be grateful if you could ...
I look forward to hearing from you.
Yours sincerely, (naam bekend) / Yours faithfully, (Dear Sir or Madam)

blocks.title: Yours sincerely of Yours faithfully?
blocks.text: In Brits Engels: begin je met de naam (Dear Mr Jones), eindig dan met Yours sincerely. Begin je met Dear Sir or Madam, eindig dan met Yours faithfully. Kind regards past bij allebei en is in e-mails gewoon.

head: Deel
Inhoud en zinnen
rows: Het onderwerp en je standpunt. Nowadays, more and more people ... In this essay I will argue that ...
On the other hand, some people believe that ... However, ...

head: Soort
Handige zinnen
rows: The film is set in ... The plot centres on ... What I liked most was ... The only drawback is ... I would highly recommend it to ...
The aim of this report is to ... Most students said that ... It was found that ... I would recommend that ... Gebruik kopjes en een formele toon.
Dear Sir or Madam, ... Yours sincerely,
Dear Sir or Madam, ... Yours faithfully,
Bij Dear Sir or Madam: Yours faithfully.
I want that you send me the form.
I would be grateful if you could send me the form.
I look forward to hear from you.
I look forward to hearing from you.
In my opinion I think that it is good.
In my opinion, it is good.
In my opinion en I think zeggen hetzelfde.
Firstly ... Secondly ... Thirdly ... Lastly in conclusion ...

blocks.text: Vul het ontbrekende woord in. De antwoorden staan op de laatste pagina.

items.q: I am writing to ______ about the delay of my order.
items.full: I am writing to complain about the delay of my order.

items.q: I would be ______ if you could send me a brochure.
items.full: I would be grateful if you could send me a brochure.

items.q: I look forward to ______ from you.
items.full: I look forward to hearing from you.
Dear Sir or Madam, ... Yours faithfully,

items.q: I would like to ______ about your summer courses.
items.full: I would like to enquire about your summer courses.

items.q: On the other ______, some people disagree.
items.full: On the other hand, some people disagree.

items.q: In ______, I believe the benefits are greater.
items.full: In conclusion, I believe the benefits are greater.

items.q: The ______ of this report is to suggest improvements.
items.full: The aim of this report is to suggest improvements.

items.q: I would highly ______ this book to teenagers.
items.full: I would highly recommend this book to teenagers.

items.q: Ik schrijf u om te klagen over de vertraging.
items.a: I am writing to complain about the delay.

items.q: Ik zou het op prijs stellen als u mij een brochure zou kunnen sturen.
items.a: I would be grateful if you could send me a brochure.
I look forward to hearing from you.

items.q: Het doel van dit verslag is verbeteringen voor te stellen.
items.a: The aim of this report is to suggest improvements.
